decisions.reason: The lever handle family builds directly on FSB's core metal, finishing and ergonomic know-how, so the firm can read its early market signals and refine it, even though it got no prominent website presence after launch.

The multifunctional lever fits the firm's barrier-free and hygiene strategy, and in-house ergonomic expertise lets management improve it, though its modest visibility leaves some risk after B and D were pruned.
The award-winning 1289 collection has its own page, clear external validation and a strong fit with core design competencies, which makes it a flagship worth keeping.
The light patinated bronze finish uses the firm's proprietary finishing expertise across coordinated product families at low marginal cost, so keeping it offers range value with little downside.
